爱莎贝儿-148CM-L 粉肤 AHR020 玄羽时子Genba Tokiko-深夜回廊
夜归时珍珠披肩滑下半边，他抵着玄关轻吻我鬓边：“这身打扮该配支华尔兹。”
蕾丝手套才脱到一半，就被他从背后圈住。他鼻尖轻蹭我后颈：“这身打扮是故意考验我？”
老唱机转动时，丝绒裙摆扫过门框，像朵夜色里绽开的墨紫鸢尾。
天鹅绒发带散开时，满屋子只剩我的心跳声。

Elsa Babe-148CM-L Pink AHR020 Genba Tokiko-Late Night Corridor
As I returned home late, my pearl shawl slipped halfway down. He leaned against the entryway and lightly kissed my temple: "This outfit deserves a waltz."
My lace gloves were only halfway off when he encircled me from behind. His nose brushed against the back of my neck: "Was this outfit a deliberate test for me?"
As the old record player spun, the velvet hem of my skirt swept across the doorway, like a dark purple iris blooming in the night.
When my velvet hairband came undone, only the sound of my heartbeat filled the room.
